messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: [Pager] High replay rate detected for service=edge-proxy (svc-edge-1). ~1.2k auth attempts in 2m from 54.37.18.0/24. Endpoint=/v1/sessions/validate Severity=P1. Runbook -> /incidents/edge-auth-probe
Sam O'Neil: acked — I'm oncall. pulling up logs and tracing upstream. tagging sec-oncall.
PriyaM: looking at raw logs now. requests are identical token strings being replayed against validate endpoint. ASN for 54.37.18.0/24 appears to be public cloud.
PriyaM: example log snippet:
```
ts=2026-03-20T12:03:21Z level=info src=edge-proxy request_id=abcd token=tok_3f4b7 user_id=- action=validate ip=54.37.18.101
```
Keith: possible token scraping or proxy replay. any recent deploys to the session caching or log forwarder?
Lila: checking deploys — staging logshipper had a change yesterday that switched target bucket. it's staging, but double-checking for misrouted creds.
security-bot: created incident INC-2026-0422, paging sec-oncall. recommended mitigations: rotate service token svc-edge-proxy, revoke active sessions, set TTL=0 for 1h where possible.
Sam O'Neil: running rotation now: `iamctl rotate-token svc-edge-proxy --immediate` — will push revocation policy after rotate. notifying SRE.
oncall-rotations: Sam O'Neil is current oncall for infra-pager. ack recorded.
PriyaM: quick followup — tokens are short-lived but we have an auth-cache layer at the CDN edge that may be serving stale validations. disabling auth-cache on edge-cache-1: `kubectl patch deploy edge-cache --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"auth-cache":"disabled"}}}}}'`
Lila: found an env var in staging: LOGSHIP_TARGET=s3://company-staging-public -> not prod but confirms a staging misconfig that uploaded debug logs. scanning that bucket for snippets.
Keith: starting scrub of staging bucket and quarantining any artifacts: `aws s3 rm s3://company-staging-public/logs/ --recursive --exclude "*" --include "*auth*"` (will record manifest).
pagerbot: mitigation in progress. severity remains P1 until rotation + validation complete. ETA requested: 30m.
PriyaM: rotation complete, revocation pushed. hitting /v1/sessions/validate shows auth success rate back to baseline, no new identical-token replays in last 5m.
security-bot: confirmed rotation for svc-edge-proxy. next recommended action: assess whether tokens were signed by customer KMS key and rotate if so. file postmortem and add root-cause follow-ups.
Sam O'Neil: coordinating CSM outreach for any customers who saw 401 spikes. no evidence of customer data exfil yet. I'll keep this incident open for 30m to monitor metrics and then transition to follow-up.
Lila: note for postmortem: add gating test to prevent staging logshipper from targeting public buckets; add a check on deploy pipeline.
Keith: manifest of scrubbed objects saved to /tmp/staging-scrub-manifest-7381122334.json and uploaded to internal-sec bucket.
Sam O'Neil: thanks all. closing on-call handoff to follow-up channel sec-postmortem in 30m unless new alerts. :thumbsup:
